items.title: Frank Chace Interview, 1961-11-18
items.q: I know Vali's early work mainly from a record... I don't know where to place Vali. Vali, all I know is that I thought that was a wonderful record.

ctx.x: One other would be Vali Defoe, who frequently plays Benny Goodman, Lake. They overlap every now and then in a conception. Twelve notes that might have been played by either one of them. Could be.

I know Vali's early work mainly from a record, I think 1924, under Spaniard's name. Why can't it be Poor Little Me and Everybody Loves My Baby? And... Gee, it's hard. I don't know where to place Vali. Vali, all I know is that I thought that was a wonderful record. Vali played beautifully. Now this is, of course, before Tesh, before Pee Wee. Where he got it from, who knows, John?

Well, I have a suggestion. Vali spoke of playing with Keppard. It probably was at Lorraine Gardens, and probably they allowed him to play the first set or two until Buster Bailey came over. He was playing on a theater job, I believe, and then played with Keppard later in the evening. But Vali was allowed to sit in until Vali came over. Now this sounds, if this is true, and was two or three years earlier, sounds as if both Buster Bailey and Vali might have been influenced by what was happening on the south side.…
